analysis:
All three changed files are CI test scripts (scripts/test-ci-component-paths.py, scripts/test-ci-tested-tree.py, scripts/test-darkbloom-route.py). None touches provider runtime, App Attest, key custody, cache crypto or other TB-002/TB-003/TB-007/TB-009/TB-011 code, so threat-model assets and the T-041 definition are not directly affected.

test-ci-component-paths.py head asserts: ci-dev/ci-master concurrency groups, with label events isolated from run-ci runs; PR opt-in via the run-ci / run-gpu-ci labels, with an unlabel job; public workflows have no secrets., no environment:, no id-token:, no repository: and no backend execution; the detector uses persist-credentials: false and contents: read; the provider-test-gate truth table. These test assertions tighten workflow hygiene.

test-ci-tested-tree.py adds tests for a squash-merge push skip via a tree-only record (lookup.tree_record_name, the tree-name CLI). The tests verify that a skip still requires a successful run, the same repository and head repository, the same workflow path, a matching tree and component coverage. The tests also assert that a pull request never matches a tree-only record. The security-relevant point is that CI skipping on master pushes depends on ci-tested-tree.py (not supplied) honoring these constraints. A tree-only record trusts the tree hash. A fork PR run is rejected through the head_repository check, which the tests cover. Real behavior in scripts/ci-tested-tree.py, the workflows and the artifact upload were not supplied, so I cannot confirm that the implementation matches the tests. Residual question: who can create artifacts named ci-tested-tree-*, and does the lookup restrict to artifacts from trusted runs? The tests suggest it does by validating the run's path, repository and head repository.

test-darkbloom-route.py has only metadata and a partial patch (lane counts, cluster_gpu gating, and a removed BUILT helper); it is routing and cost configuration with no security impact visible. No findings; deeper review is optional for the unchanged implementation.
